newsitem.title: USA: Loch Harris acquires 19 oil/gas leaseholds.
newsitem.headline: Loch Harris acquires 19 oil/gas leaseholds.

text.p: Loch Harris Inc said Wednesday it acquired 19 producing oil and gas leaseholds containing 1,800 contiguous acres of producing, proved developed, proved undeveloped and behind-the-pipe reserves in east central Oklahoma.
The new holdings will be operated as a division of Loch Harris under the direction of chairman Dennis B. Harris, said R.B. Baker, president of the company.
He said that for book value purposes, the company uses $12 per barrel of and $2 per million cubic feed of gas with future earnings estimated to be more than $29 million dollars.
He said reserves of the acquired assets are reported at eight billion cubic feet of gas and 956,000 barrels of oil, discounted at 12 percent.

Current prices being paid for gas on the producing wells range from a high of $3.7954 per million cubic feet to a low of $1.6894 per million cubic feet and oil has been fluctuating from $18.50 to $21.00 per barrel, he said.
Current production cash flow will be used to equip and produce additional wells, he said.
All original and supplemental geological and engineering data, logs and core samples were acquired as part of the purchase, he said.
